name: Live Activities and Dynamic Island
plain: Pins a live status (delivery, score, ride) to the lock screen and Dynamic Island for up to 8 hours.
meaning: A glanceable always-on channel that shows where a person's order or ride is. It runs a long way under the OS: 8 hours active, then up to 4 more on the lock screen.

android.permission: POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFICATIONS for Live Updates (Android 16); see mob.notif.android-live-updates
android.prompt_ui: Promoted ongoing notification and status chip
android.persistence: Until app ends or user dismisses
android.store_policy: Play policy: not for ads or chat
android.note: Closest analog is Android 16 Live Updates

ios.prompt_ui: Per app Live Activities toggle in Settings
ios.persistence: Active up to 8 hours; after ending stays on Lock Screen up to 4 hours by default; ends if user force quits
ios.revocation: Settings > App > Live Activities; swipe away; Focus
ios.note: Payload for updates about 4 KB; up to 8 hours active, up to 4 hours lock screen retention after end; a few concurrent activities per app (documented about 5)

limits.headline: Can pin live status to your iPhone lock screen for up to 8 hours
limits.user_action: You start a ride, order, game or timer, and the app starts a Live Activity
can: Show things like delivery progress or a score on the lock screen
Use the Dynamic Island on iPhone 14 Pro and newer
Keep updating while the activity runs, up to 8 hours
Stay visible on the lock screen up to 4 hours after it ends
cannot: Run it if you turned Live Activities off for that app
Run unlimited activities at once; each app gets only a few
Match it exactly on Android, where the closest feature is Live Updates on Android 16
limits.differs: iPhone has Live Activities from iOS 16.1. Android 16 has a similar Live Updates feature.

story.what_it_is: A live status card, like a delivery or score, pinned to the iPhone lock screen and Dynamic Island.

marketing.name: Live Activities
marketing.pitch: Apple pitches Live Activities as a way to show live information like a ride or score on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

story.for_you: You order a ride and see the car and time left on the lock screen and the Dynamic Island. It updates itself, and you can end it any time.
story.for_makers: Makers get an always visible spot that is hard to ignore. They use it for time bound tasks, and it also keeps the app in front of people.

use_cases.example: A food order shows a live progress bar from kitchen to your door.
A football match shows the live score on the lock screen.
Your ride shows the car, driver and arrival time on the Dynamic Island.
A flight shows gate, boarding and delay changes live.
A workout or run shows pace and time in the Dynamic Island.
A game shows a build timer or a match countdown on the lock screen.
A music app shows what is playing and a quick control.

risks: Can show private info on a locked screen
story.android_note: Android 16 has a close match called Live Updates.
story.ios_note: Runs up to 8 hours, then stays on the lock screen up to 4 more. You can turn it off per app.

technical_bounds: Update frequency limited by an hourly push budget
